logic.description: Implemented as a monster natural permanent — never cast (creature innate, in_player_deck false). Natural: exactly as Love — an enemy that came in contact cannot damage the holder until it visits its tower (entry hex) or the copies fall. Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again.

prerequisites.description: Held only by a wild monster whose creature card has this innate effect (no companion / summon / hero).
The enemy is in contact with the holder.

effects.description: Damage the target may deal to the caster while the permanent stands.
Natural: an afflicted enemy's damage to the holder is dropped.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys ONE copy when it is at least 6.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_air (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The effect stays flagged creature_innate (it is dealt to the awakened creature per Rule 3; a vote may still change in_player_deck).
The natural_permanent block (copies, power, semantics) stays.
